capabilities: generate a tavern with name, size, prestige, prices and atmosphere
build food and drink menus scaled to prestige
create available rooms for the tavern
populate taverns with NPCs and rumors as plot hooks
edit dictionaries and generation tables for custom settings
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. README lists installation steps and command-palette usage, but no screenshots or troubleshooting.
problem: Game Masters spend time inventing tavern details (names, menus, patrons, plot hooks) by hand when running tabletop sessions.
summary: A tavern generator that creates detailed DnD establishments with menus, rooms, patrons and rumors, and inserts them into notes.
